## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical canary rollout skills using service mesh and metrics to guard upgrades.

## Key Concepts
- Canary deployments per tenant
- Istio VirtualService traffic splitting
- Basic rollback and monitoring thresholds
- Minimal, in-namespace validation

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example: Istio VirtualService snippet for 10% canary
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
  name: gateway-tenantA
spec:
  http:
  - route:
    - destination:
        host: gateway-tenantA
        subset: baseline
      weight: 90
    - destination:
        host: gateway-tenantA
        subset: canary
      weight: 10
```

## Validation Commands
```bash
kubectl get pods -n tenant-namespace
kubectl get virtualservice gateway-tenantA -n tenant-namespace
kubectl get destinationrule gateway-tenantA -n tenant-namespace
```

```yaml
      names:
        kind: K8sTenantAccess
```

## Why This Is Asked

```go
// Pseudo Go-like sketch
type Sidecar struct{ allow map[string]struct{} }
func (s *Sidecar) Handle(req *Request){
  id := req.Header.Get("X-TENANT-ID")
  if _, ok := s.allow[id]; !ok { respond403(); return }
  forward(req)
  log("tenant", id, "path", req.Path, "status", resp.Status)
}
```

questions.explanation:
Why This Is Asked
- Tests reliability patterns in CNF deployments. 
- Exercises understanding of the sidecar pattern, process supervision, and per-tenant isolation.
- Checks how backoff, crash loops, and health endpoints are wired in Kubernetes.

Key Concepts
- Process supervision and exit handling in a container.
- Per-tenant state via labels/annotations and isolated metrics.
- Liveness/readiness semantics and crash-loop protection.

Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  labels:
    app: cnf-gateway
    tenant: <tenant-id>
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: cnf-gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cnf-gateway
        tenant: <tenant-id>
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: cnf-main
          image: cnf/main:latest
        - name: watchdog
          image: cnf/watchdog:latest
          env:
            - name: CNF_MAIN_BIN
              value: "/cnf/main/bin/cnf"
          volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: "/cnf/main/bin"
              name: bin
      volumes:
        - name: bin
          emptyDir: {}
```

Follow-up Questions
- How would you add jitter to the backoff to avoid thundering herd? 
- How would you test crash-loop protection in CI/CD?
